title: CSS Grid
goal: Create a layout with rows and columns.
explanation: Grid is useful when both rows and columns matter. Define tracks on the grid container; its direct children become grid items.
The fr unit shares remaining space. repeat avoids repeating track definitions. minmax sets a minimum and maximum, and auto-fit can adapt the number of columns to available space.
Keep the document order meaningful. Visually reordering cards should not make keyboard focus or screen-reader reading order confusing.
exercise: Make a responsive gallery of six cards and verify that a narrow view does not scroll horizontally.
hint: Set display: grid on the gallery. Keep card widths flexible.

quiz.question: What does 1fr represent in Grid?
options: A fraction of remaining track space
quiz.explanation: fr divides available space among flexible tracks; it is not a fixed measurement.
